bloodAddled.impact: This changes multiplayer hostility behaviour while the relevant rune conditions are met.
bloodAddled.info: Enables the Blood-addled interaction associated with co-op players using the Hunter rune.
bloodAddled.label: Enable Blood-addled co-op behaviour
bloodAddled.warning: Use this only offline or with consenting players. It can create confusing hostile co-op behaviour.

dollLullaby.impact: This restores a legacy presentation state. It does not alter attributes, inventory or quest rewards.
dollLullaby.info: Re-enables the Doll’s lullaby behaviour associated with the original 1.0 release.
dollLullaby.label: Enable the Doll’s legacy lullaby
dollLullaby.warning: The behaviour is version-sensitive; keep the backup until you have loaded the character successfully.

multiplayerDefeatedBosses.impact: Only the multiplayer bit of each area listed in the boss timeline is cleared. Boss progress, items and rewards are unchanged.
multiplayerDefeatedBosses.info: Clears the multiplayer lock the game applies to an area once its boss is defeated, so co-op and invasions can work there again.
multiplayerDefeatedBosses.label: Re-enable multiplayer after defeated bosses
multiplayerDefeatedBosses.warning: Upstream testing reports that Cathedral Ward, Yahar'gul and the DLC areas may stay locked. Setting a boss back to Dead locks its area again once every boss there is defeated.

restoreMaria.impact: This changes the dialogue state only; it does not grant an item, level or boss reward.
restoreMaria.info: Restores a small set of dialogue lines before the Lady Maria encounter.
restoreMaria.label: Restore Lady Maria dialogue
restoreMaria.warning: Use on a copied save first if you are currently in the Astral Clocktower area.

flags.introduction: Only independently documented byte patterns are shown here. Unknown offsets are deliberately excluded to protect the save from accidental corruption.
flags.safetyDescription: Apply one change at a time, then use Save changes. Keep the automatically created backup until the character loads normally.
flags.title: Known Flags

home.lead: Open a decrypted Bloodborne character save to inspect inventory, attributes, character settings, bosses and flags. The editor creates a backup when a file is opened; always retain it until you have checked the result in-game.
home.stepOneDescription: PlayStation exports must be decrypted before they can be read by the editor.
home.stepThreeDescription: Test the exported file before removing the automatic .bak copy.
home.stepTwoDescription: Review each change and avoid using modified saves in online play.
home.title: Edit deliberately. Preserve your hunt.

ps4.description: With an FTP server on the console (GoldHEN on PS4, port 2121; etaHEN on PS5, port 1337) you can open a decrypted save, edit it and send it back. On PS4 the editor lists the folders where Apollo exported Bloodborne saves. Apollo has no PS5 version, so on PS5 you browse to the save yourself.
